text:
tara_cs: Heads-up — HelixMaps (dedicated trial) usage collapsed to ~9% overnight. Renewal in ~3 weeks. Can we triage before the executive sync? :warning:

mike_se: Looking. Any errors (5xx/401/429) or did they throttle?

sara_data: Quick numbers: tokens/hr avg ~6.1k last week -> 540 yesterday. Error breakdown: 8% 401, 3% 429, negligible 5xx. Drop window starts ~2026-01-12 02:40 UTC. Chart: https://dash.redwood.internal/nb/helixmaps/usage (internal)

ana_ae: New security lead (Devon) onboarded last week; they also kicked off a short pilot with NovaAI for embeddings. Devon mentioned cost and data residency concerns.

leo_onboard: Onboarding logs show several session warmup aborts around 02:45 UTC. I can resend warmup script and a short checklist.

monitor_bot: [ALERT] sudden-usage-drop detected for customer: helixmaps. Runbook: triage-auth + cs-offer-cost-safety. Incident ID: INC-HEL-20260112-9

mike_se: Running synthetics to their dedicated host. If validators didn't pick up a rotated key we'll see 401s.

mike_se: Synthetic result: 50 requests -> 46 OK, 4 401. Validator logs show token signer rotated at 02:42 but validator cache TTL still at 15m on their trial cluster.

sara_data: SQL I ran:

```
SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) hr, sum(tokens) AS tokens
FROM usage.events
WHERE customer = 'helixmaps' AND ts >= now() - interval '14 days'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 72;
```

Drop pinned to 2026-01-12 02:40 UTC. CSV: /shared/helixmaps/2026-01-12-drop.csv

tara_cs: Proposed actions:
- Mike: force validator key refresh + reduce TTL to 1m on the trial validators. Owner: @mike_se. ETA 1h.
- Leo: push warmup script + restart checklist to HelixMaps infra and offer a guided restart. Owner: @leo_onboard. ETA 3h.
- Ana: reach out to Devon with a cost-safety offer (10% credits for 2 weeks) and propose a short cost/latency comparison vs NovaAI. Owner: @ana_ae. ETA EOD.
- Sara: prepare hour-by-hour recovery slide for exec sync. Owner: @sara_data. ETA 2h.

leo_onboard: Will include a minimal resume job example to avoid bill shock.

mike_se: Patching TTL and forcing keyset refresh now. Will post logs when done.

monitor_bot: [ACTION] INC-HEL-20260112-9 assigned to oncall-eng. Priority: P2.

mike_se: Patch applied. 401 rate dropped from 8% -> 0.4% in 10 minutes. Validator logs show new key accepted.

sara_data: Traffic recovered to ~82% baseline 40m after patch. Recovery CSV: /shared/helixmaps/2026-01-12-recovery.csv

ana_ae: Devon is receptive to a short comparison. I'll schedule a 30-min QBR/demo and include the cost-safety offer.

tara_cs: Good. If we don't hit >75% baseline within 24h escalate to renewal-engage. Follow-ups: Ana outreach, Leo confirm restart success, Mike monitor for key TTL regressions, Sara final slide. Reconvene only if regression. :thumbsup:
